title: Teach Without the Robot
subtitle: How high-fidelity human demonstrations reach real-robot deployment

paper.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
paper.authors: Simple AI; Yuteng Wei; Jinming Ma; Jiawei Wang; Weitao Zhou; Yushen Zuo; Ke Rui; Minglei Li; Jinhao Zhang; Zhikang Pan; Xiang Wang; Haoran Jia; Huan Du; Zicheng Zeng; Jun Ma; Guiyu Qin; Di Zhang; Xiaofei Li
paper.sourceNote: The official project exposes the paper and HiFi-UMI-2K dataset, but no implementation repository.

chapters.title: Six Views, One Instant
chapters.blurb: Six camera views, ultra-wide hand coverage, and one hardware trigger turn a human gesture into a synchronized episode with measured quality signals.

chapters.title: Reconstruct the Hands
chapters.blurb: Offline stereo-inertial reconstruction and two marker cubes in one head frame recover globally consistent bimanual trajectories with three-millimeter local error.

chapters.title: Replay Before Training
chapters.blurb: Two serial quality gates reconstruct and replay every capture before annotation, human verification, balancing, and traceable export.

chapters.title: Remove the Robot Anchor
chapters.blurb: Controlled within-backbone comparisons remove task teleoperation, then test what four thousand hours of robot-free pre-training add—and where the evidence stops.
